name: library-erp
description: Library ERP — offline, keyboard se chalne wala, activation key ke saath

scripts.build: pkg . -t node22-win-x64 --no-bytecode --public --public-packages "*" -o dist/LibraryERP.exe && node patch-gui.js dist/LibraryERP.exe && pkg keygen.js -t node22-win-x64 --no-bytecode --public --public-packages "*" -o dist/LibraryKeygen.exe
